# Spawn As (Zeus)

Pick **which side newly placed Zeus units join**. Want NATO troops as the enemy? Select **OPF** and place them from the BLUFOR tree: they are OPFOR the moment they hit the ground. No spawning far away and changing sides afterwards, no friendly firefight.

## Features

- **Spawn As strip** right next to the side tabs of the Zeus Create panel: **DEFAULT / BLU / OPF / IND / CIV**.
- **Instant**: units join the chosen side in the same moment they're placed.
- Units and groups from the Units, Groups and Recent trees, and the crews of crewed vehicles.
- **Only the side changes**: uniform, gear, voice and insignia stay.
- **Banner** under the mission clock while a side is active.
- **Keybind** to cycle the side (CBA, rebindable), default **Ctrl+Shift+S**.
- Every Zeus has their own setting; it starts at DEFAULT each mission.

## Usage

Open Zeus, click a side in the **SPAWN AS** strip left of the side tabs (or press Ctrl+Shift+S), place units as usual. Click **DEFAULT** to go back to normal spawning.

Left alone: empty vehicles and objects, modules (including spawners with their own side), markers and everything already on the map.

## Requirements

- [CBA_A3](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=450814997)

Works with and without [Zeus Enhanced](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1779063631).

In multiplayer, load the mod on the **server and all clients**. The mod is signed; the key is in the mod's keys folder.

## Source & issues

Open source (MIT) on [GitHub](https://github.com/CodeTappert/ZeusSpawnAs). Bug reports and ideas welcome there.

This project was written with the help of AI coding assistants. All changes are reviewed and tested by the maintainer.
